strategy.name: sma_regime_conditions_1_3_short_sma_rising_and_3pct_lockout_ablation
strategy.description: 以已经去掉旧条件 2 和旧 8% 止损的条件 1+3 策略为基础，做两个新措施的完整 2×2 消融。基础主条件是完成 Close 后 Close>SMA200 且 SMA200>SMA250>SMA300。措施 1 把 SMA25、SMA30、SMA35 各自严格高于前一交易日加入主条件，任一持平或下跌即不满足。措施 2 在单次持仓中用实际入场价及此前已完成 Close 维护盘前已知峰值；当日 Low 首次到达峰值下方 3% 时立即卖出，开盘跳空低于止损价则按 Open，否则按精确 3% 阈值。只有该 3% 卖出会进入特殊回买锁定：路径 A 是完成 Close 回到或高于实际卖出价且主条件全满足；否则路径 B 必须在止损后依次由完成 Close 下穿 SMA200、到达或低于 SMA200×95%、再从下方向上穿越 SMA200，之后主条件全满足。两个窗口和四个 case 均独立从现金开始。
strategy.buy_rule: 普通空仓且未处于 3% 止损锁定时，完成 Close 后主条件全部成立，下一交易日 Open 全仓买入。3% 止损锁定时，只有完成 Close>=该次实际止损卖出价且主条件全满足，或已依次完成 Close<SMA200、Close<=SMA200×95%、随后前 Close<=前 SMA200 且今 Close>SMA200 并且主条件全满足，才在下一交易日 Open 全仓买回。措施 1 启用时，主条件额外要求 SMA25(t)>SMA25(t-1)、SMA30(t)>SMA30(t-1)、SMA35(t)>SMA35(t-1)。
strategy.sell_rule: 持仓且完成 Close 后任一启用主条件不满足，则下一交易日 Open 全部卖出；这种主条件卖出不激活特殊回买锁定。措施 2 启用时，每个交易日前以实际入场价与此前完成 Close 的最大值为已知峰值，预先放置峰值×97%的当日止损；Open 已低于等于阈值则按 Open 卖出，否则 Low 触及阈值就按阈值当日卖出。止损卖出后激活特殊回买锁定。主条件次日 Open 卖出与当日盘中止损若竞争，以更早实际发生的次日 Open 主条件卖出为准。
strategy.signal_time: 主条件、卖价恢复和 SMA200 重置路径均在完成 Close 后判定。3% 盘中止损阈值在当日开盘前，只用实际入场价和此前完成 Close 计算；不使用当日 High 或未来数据。
strategy.execution_time: 主条件买卖和两条锁定回买路径均在下一交易日 Open 执行。3% 止损为同一交易日预放条件单：跳空按 Open，非跳空 Low 触及时按精确阈值。允许次日 Open 买回后同日盘中再次止损。
strategy.position_sizing: long-only；每个 case-window 独立从 100,000 美元现金开始；买入使用全部现金，卖出清空；允许小数股，不融资，现金不计息。
strategy.initial_position: 每个窗口首日空仓；窗口前数据只预热 SMA，不继承任何仓位、现金、峰值、卖出价或重置阶段。

parameters.measure_1_operator: each current SMA must be strictly greater than its own previous-session value
parameters.measure_2_stop_peak: maximum of actual entry fill and completed closes strictly before the current session
parameters.measure_2_recovery_operator: completed Close >= actual 3% stop sell fill
measure_2_reset_sequence: completed Close crosses from <= SMA200 to > SMA200

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: For each independent window, invest the same 100,000 USD in QQQ at the Open following the first completed window Close and hold through the window end Close without artificial liquidation.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v3 unchanged for the formal interactive run report. Additionally generate one print-specific HTML and one combined PDF whose first page states the tested rules before any results.

research.hypothesis: Measure 1, measure 2, or their combination can reduce maximum drawdown of the conditions 1+3 base strategy consistently in both independently initialized 2010–2015 and 2020–2026 windows.
research.primary_metric: Maximum drawdown is primary. Total return, CAGR, Sharpe, exposure, orders, and stop/re-entry counts report the cost and mechanics; no parameter is selected.
research.selection_rule: No selection or winner is promoted. Report all four predeclared cases in both windows and compare each measure case with the base in the same window.
research.validation_plan: For each of eight case-window paths, reconcile PyBroker with an independent state-machine ledger in dates, sides, fill prices, cash, shares, equity, and closed trades. Add golden tests for strict short-SMA rises, gap/threshold 3% fills, both re-entry paths, ordered reset stages, and same-day buy then stop. Render one combined PDF and verify its page count, PDF header, and extracted first-page text.
research.promotion_criteria: A measure is only a stronger follow-up candidate if it reduces maximum drawdown versus base in both windows without catastrophic return loss and without ledger divergence. Two retrospective windows are still insufficient for paper trading.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject the run if the old 8% rule remains, measure 1 uses an average instead of all three separate strict rises, an equal/flat short SMA is accepted, the 3% stop uses current High to raise its threshold, the lock is activated by an ordinary main-condition exit, reset events occur out of order, windows inherit state, any case is omitted, the PDF starts with results rather than the strategy definition, or the two ledgers diverge.
